name: ext3/4 journaling support for the NetBSD kernel

mentions.name: ext3/4 journaling support for the NetBSD kernel
mentions.description: This project implements ext3/4 filesystem journaling support for the NetBSD kernel. It currently opens, reads, and replays the journal upon mount, with work remaining to log disk transactions during use.
mentions.source_excerpt: cleaning up my ext3/4 journalling code for the NetBSD kernel. I've got it opening, reading, and replaying the journal upon mount, now I need to move on to getting it to actually log disk transactions during use.
mentions.author: bitwize
